Observed 2026-10-03 in commitgraph right after 'bead sync configure --mode sharded': the transition tombstones the outgoing monolith root (plan 6.1.1) while previous.json still references it, and 'bead doctor' reports 'ERROR secret_scan: Secret diagnostic failed: I/O error: .../objects/<old-root>.jsonl'.
